game.title: Invisible Soldier: Shadow Ops
game.lead: An immersive tactical stealth experience that puts your survival skills to the ultimate test behind enemy lines.
game.storyText: Deep within a mysterious facility, you awaken as the only operative capable of uncovering the truth. Your weapon isn't your greatest asset—your shadow is. Every heartbeat could betray your position.

media.title: Media & Gallery
media.lead: Explore the world of The Invisible Soldier through exclusive screenshots and gameplay footage.

idea.title: Core Idea
idea.description: The game focuses on a personal journey in a world affected by a traumatic experience.
points: Stage One: Direct confrontation with enemies (Combat).
Subsequent Stages: Experience shifts towards exploration and internal understanding.
Combat is not the primary goal, but a reflection of the character's psychological state.

character.title: Main Character
character.name: Muslih
character.motive: Understanding his personal experience and helping the city recover as part of his psychological journey.
character.conflict: Anxiety, guilt, emotional detachment, and searching for meaning after survival.

narrative.title: Narrative Background
points: Muslih lived through a traumatic experience that left deep psychological scars.
He tries to adapt by repairing the city and helping people.
He believes that fixing what is broken around him might help him understand what is broken within.
The journey is dual: External (city repair) and Internal (self-discovery).
Decisions reveal new aspects of his personality, moving beyond absolute right and wrong.

world.title: Game World
world.description: An urban, semi-destroyed environment including neighborhoods, towers, and damaged infrastructure.
world.style: The environment itself tells the story (Environmental Storytelling).

gameplay.title: Gameplay Style
items: Exploration: Moving and interacting with locations and characters.
Information Gathering: May be useful later.
Narrative Decisions: Impact Muslih's psychological journey.
Direct Confrontation: Primarily present in the first stage only.

mechanics.title: Core Mechanics
items: Making decisions that reveal character layers.

progression.title: Progression
progression.description: Divided into stages/chapters, each uncovering a new layer of Muslih's psychological state. The end of the first stage leaves the player with unresolved emotional questions.

themes.title: Themes
items: Repair as a Means of Healing.

art.title: Art Direction
art.description: Muted color palette with selective lighting, realistic yet poetic environmental details, and a simple, unobtrusive UI.

audio.title: Sound and Music
audio.description: Quiet ambient sound effects, environmental sounds carrying narrative meaning, and intentional use of silence.

usp.title: Unique Selling Points
items: Visual storytelling without heavy reliance on dialogue.
An experience with a distinct Arabic cultural identity.
Focus on emotional impact over winning.
